in_marathi.name: Elvishay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Elvishay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Elvishay is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Elvi' meaning God and 'Shay' meaning grace. This name signifies the divine grace bestowed upon an individual by the gods.
